entries.subject: DAMIT 456: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-456.txt. Model 456, version 2016-04-22, pole (311°, -78°), period 6.803286 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 1.2 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: No registered reusable reflectance texture was examined for the selected model. The grid marks missing imagery; Elevation is source-model radius relative to a sphere, not measured geology.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: The checked DAMIT target listing supplies only selected model 456; it did not identify another DAMIT mesh to compare. That bounded listing does not rule out alternatives in other releases. Rotation phase remains arbitrary.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Cerberus thermophysical scale uncertainty
entries.finding: The selected archive scale is 1.2 km, but its diameter uncertainty is absent and retained as unknown. Hanuš et al. (2015), section 4.2, reports a poor Cerberus thermophysical fit and omits a usable uncertainty. The DAMIT calibrated-size flag therefore does not establish a strong physical-size validation; no zero error, total confidence interval or local shape accuracy is inferred.
